method: Built-in image_gen, one call per variation

variants.name: a-fields-and-lane
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Festival Tycoon non-playable background environment concept, wide 16:9 in-game isometric view.
Inputs: Image 1 is authoritative CURRENT GAME spatial reference (ignore HUD, text, yellow selection rings and thousands of tiny litter dots from a stress test). Image 2 is approved crafted low-poly STYLE only, not layout.
Preserve the current farm square's footprint and recognizable internal arrangement from image 1: large stone double-height barn upper-left, smaller barn behind/right of it along far edge; stone farmhouse left; straight ochre entrance dirt lane from big barn to gate at lower-right edge; little trailer stage lower centre-left of lane; green first aid tent near farmhouse/lane; cream food van and wooden drinks stall on other side of lane; teal portable toilet, steward shelter near gate. Same buildings, modest sizes and spatial relationships, no new festival features. Frame the ENTIRE square with surrounding terrain visible on EVERY edge. Farm occupies about 55 percent image width, centred. Same elevated orthographic game angle as screenshot, no horizon panorama or close-up. Remove all HUD, text, labels, selection effects, litter stress-test dots. Centre geometry should look like the existing game, warmed gently by approved style.
Primary request: surround the existing playable hedged square with continuous non-playable English rural ground. Ground meets farm at same elevation and naturally fills whole frame to edges, no floating island, vertical slab edges, plinth, blue void or blank studio background. Boundary hedge remains clearly legible, entrance lane continues out through exact gate into countryside. Broad quiet warm green/earth colour fields, simple matte low-poly models with restrained facets, no mosaic/triangular checkerboard ground, no dense grass blades/flowers, no elaborate textures. Background details less saturated/contrasty than festival. Static economical geometry, sparse repeated low-poly tree shapes, no huge trees blocking farm. Surround is a complete 360-degree landscape with an open low verge around entire square; trees set well away so all four camera sides stay usable. Soft warm daylight. No text or graphic labels.
Variation: A / simplest grounding: mostly flat pasture and two or three broad irregular cultivated field shapes separated by low hedgerows. A handful of distant clustered trees. Extend the dirt lane across near countryside, curving gently beyond gate towards frame edge. No extra buildings. Ground nearly flat, only very subtle far relief. Calm practical inexpensive field surround, broad uncluttered foreground.
